2024 Mourvèdre, Red Mountain

100% Mourvèdre. Heart of the Hill Vineyard, Red Mountain AVA. "This wine will turn your thoughts about Red Mt. on their head. It's also one of the best examples of Mourvèdre I've had from Washington. The aromas offer notes of freshly ground black pepper, crushed flower, fresh herb, red fruit, and red licorice, showing crystalline purity. Medium-bodied, cranberry tart, crunchy red fruit flavors follow. This is all about liveliness and purity, bringing both is spades. It's an accomplishement of wine that will have along life ahead of it." - Sean Sullivan
